en.help_title: A club worth coming back to.
en.help_content:
1. Challenge Dockside Union. Choose a legal discard after drawing. Three AI players take their turns automatically.

2. Riichi needs a closed, ready hand and 1,000 points. Complete four melds and a pair (or a special hand) with a valid yaku. Dora alone is not a yaku.

3. When legal, Ron / Tsumo / Chi / Pon / Kan appear among actions. Passing a win can affect furiten; the rule engine enforces it.

4. Win positive points for a larger club reward. Train for XP and levels, sign players and replace four skill slots.

5. Reputation unlocks club nodes. Make one story choice, then save outside a match.
en.riichi_desc: Declare riichi when your hand is closed and ready (tenpai). Cost: 1,000 points. You discard one tile and the rest of the hand plays automatically. If you win, riichi adds to your scoring.
en.ron_desc: Win by claiming a tile another player discarded. Only legal when the discarded tile completes your hand with at least one yaku.
en.tsumo_desc: Win by drawing the tile that completes your hand yourself. All other players pay your winnings proportionally.
en.chi_desc: Claim a discard to complete a sequence (chow) on your left side. Only the player to your left can chi. Opens your hand.
en.pon_desc: Claim a discard to complete a triplet (pung). Any player can pon. Opens your hand. Costs a yaku in some rules.
en.kan_desc: Claim or declare four-of-a-kind. There are four types: closed kan (concealed), open kan (from discard), added kan (after pon), and stacked kan. Each reveals a new dora indicator.
en.furiten_desc: You are in furiten if any of your discards could complete your winning hand. You cannot ron while in furiten. Permanent furiten applies if you pass a winning tile at any point.

zh.help_subtitle: 快速开始 / 玩法说明
zh.help_content:
1. 挑战码头联盟。摸牌后选择合法弃牌。三位AI玩家自动轮流出牌。

2. 立直需要门前清听牌和1,000点。完成四面子一刻（或特殊牌型）并满足至少一个役种。仅宝牌不构成役种。

3. 合法时，荣和/自摸/吃/碰/杠会出现在操作中。放过和牌可能影响振听；规则引擎会强制执行。

4. 正分获得更大俱乐部奖励。训练获得经验和等级，签约选手并替换四个技能槽。

5. 声望解锁俱乐部节点。做出一个故事选择，然后在局外保存。
zh.riichi_desc: 当手牌为门前清且听牌时宣布立直。费用：1,000点。你打出一张牌，剩余手牌自动进行。如果和牌，立直增加得分。
zh.ron_desc: 通过宣称其他玩家打出的牌来和牌。仅当该弃牌完成你的手牌且至少有一个役种时合法。
zh.tsumo_desc: 通过自己摸到完成手牌的牌来和牌。其他所有玩家按比例支付你的 winnings。
zh.chi_desc: 宣称弃牌来完成你左侧的顺子。只有你左侧的玩家可以吃。打开你的手牌。
zh.pon_desc: 宣称弃牌来完成刻子。任何玩家都可以碰。打开你的手牌。某些规则中需要役种。
zh.kan_desc: 宣称或声明四张相同的牌。有四种类型：暗杠（门前）、明杠（从弃牌）、加杠（碰后）、双杠。每种都会揭示一张新的宝牌指示牌。
zh.furiten_desc: 如果你的任何弃牌能完成你的和牌手牌，你就处于振听状态。振听期间不能荣和。如果你在任何时候放过一张和牌，永久振听生效。
